transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess I’m here because… most days I wake up already feeling weighed down. Like this gray kind of heaviness. Even when I’m working with the crew or around my kids, it’s still there. I’m just… going through the motions, mostly.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About three years, I guess. A little over that… maybe three years and a few months. It started when our groundskeeping contract changed and the longer days kind of took over.
Do you find yourself enjoying things that you used to like before you started feeling this way?
I don’t know… I guess I haven’t really thought about it that way. Things just feel kind of the same now. I do what I need to do, but… enjoyment isn’t something I notice much.
Are there things you used to enjoy that you no longer find pleasure in?
I’m not sure. I mean… I don’t really think about what I used to enjoy. I still do some things, but it’s hard to say if I’m getting pleasure out of them. It’s just… kind of flat, I guess.
Can you think of anything recently that you've done and actually felt happy about?
Not really… I mean, nothing comes to mind. I get through things, but I wouldn’t say I’ve felt happy about much lately.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in activities you used to find enjoyable?
I don’t really know. I guess I don’t pay much attention to whether I’m interested or not. I just… do things if they need doing.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that most people would find enjoyable?
I don’t know… “unable” sounds kind of strong. I guess I just don’t notice much pleasure either way. Things are just… there.
Have you ever thought about ending your life?
I… I don’t really want to get into that. I’m not sure how to answer.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself?
I don’t know… I don’t really want to talk about that. Can we maybe leave it there for now?
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight over the past few months?
Not really sure. I don’t weigh myself much. My clothes seem about the same, I guess.
Do you feel like you're moving slower or faster than you used to, or that your movements feel different in any way?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed anything like that… maybe I’m just tired sometimes, but my movements seem about the same.
Do you often feel guilty about things?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes. I try not to sit around thinking about it too much.
Do you often feel worthless?
I don’t know… worthless is a strong word. I guess I don’t really think about it like that.
Do you feel like you're resting or sleeping more than you used to?
I’m not sure… I don’t think I’m sleeping more, exactly. I rest when I can, but I haven’t really kept track.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than you used to?
I don’t really know. I mean… I get through what I have to do. I haven’t noticed moving slower, exactly.
Have you been having any thoughts about ending your life recently?
I… I don’t know. I don’t really want to talk about that, I guess. Nothing specific I can say.
Do you feel like your movements or activity level have changed in any way since you started feeling this heaviness?
I’m not really sure. I still get around and do what I need to do… maybe I’m not as quick about things, but I haven’t paid much attention to it.
Do you feel like you have been fidgeting more or having trouble sitting still lately?
Not really. I mean, I don’t think I’m fidgeting more. I can sit still fine, I guess… I just haven’t noticed anything like that.
Do you feel like you've been moving more slowly than usual?
I don’t know… maybe a little, but I haven’t really noticed. I still do what I have to do.
Have you been having any thoughts about harming yourself recently?
I… I don’t really want to get into that. I’m not sure how to answer.
